urdu transliteration:
TERI JAGEER SE CHAL PADA QAFELA
AY MERE BAWAFA HAI BEHAN BERIDA
MERE GHAZI KAHAN HO
english translation text:
From your domain, the caravan has departed.
O my loyal one, your sister now stands unveiled.
Where is my Ghazi?

urdu transliteration:
TUJHKO DEKHE BINA CHAIN AATA NAHI
NOKE NAIZA PE SAR TERA MILTA NAHI
MAI ZIYARAT KAROON KIS TARHA YE BATA
english translation text:
Without being able to see you, my heart finds no peace.
Your head upon the spear is nowhere to be found.
Tell me, how am I to perform your ziyarat?

urdu transliteration:
LAAJ RAKHLO BEHAN KI BARADAR MERE
KHAAKE MAQTAL MERE SAR KA PARDA BANE
HUKM DEDO ZARA MUNTAZIR HAI HAWA
english translation text:
Protect your sister's honour, O my brother.
Let the dust of the battlefield become a veil for my head.
Give but one command—the wind awaits your order.

urdu transliteration:
TERE BAAZU MUJHE RAASTE MAY MILAY
MAINE CHADAR SAMAJH KAR WO SAR PAR RAKHE
BAZOON SE TERA POOCHTI HOON PATA
english translation text:
Your arms I found upon the road.
I placed them upon my head as though they were my veil.
From your severed arms I ask for news of you.

urdu transliteration:
DEKH KAR BEHAN KO DASHT MAY NANGE SAR
KYA HAYA AAGAYI CHUP GAYE HO KIDHAR
KHUD CHALI AAUNGI TUM BATADO ZARA
english translation text:
Seeing your sister without a cover over her head in the desert,
Did modesty overcome you, causing you to hide?
Tell me where you are, and I shall come myself.

urdu transliteration:
MAINE BACHPAN MAY LORI SUNAYI TUJHE
MAINE CHALNA SIKHAYA THA BHAI TUJHE
RAAHE PURKHAAR PAR MUJHKO CHALNA SIKHA
english translation text:
In childhood, I sang lullabies to you.
Brother, it was I who taught you how to walk.
Now teach me how to walk this path filled with thorns.

urdu transliteration:
WO TERI LAADLI WO SAKINA TERI
CHALTE NAAQE SE JAB KHAAK PAR GIR GAYI
DEKHTI REHGAYI WO SUYE ALQAMA
english translation text:
That beloved girl of yours, your Sakina,
When she fell from the moving camel onto the earth,
She kept looking towards the river.

urdu transliteration:
JO BANE MURTAZA MAI WO EHSAAS HOON
BERIDA BIBIYON KI MAI ABBAS HOON
TUM MERI AAS THAY AY MERE BAWAFA
english translation text:
I am the reflection of that feeling which made you Abbas.
I am the Abbas of these unveiled ladies.
You were my hope, O my loyal one.

urdu transliteration:
WAARISE AMBIYA KI MAI HAMSHEER HOON
AYNE HAIDER HOON QURAN KI TAFSEER HOON
KOI YAWAR NAHI KISKO DOON MAI SADA
english translation text:
I am the sister of the heir of the Prophets.
I am the mirror of Haider, the tafsir of the Qur'an.
There is no helper left—whom shall I call upon?
